ask: Turn our launch notes into a 3-part X thread, with the dashboard screenshot on the last part: https://cdn.example.com/dashboard.png

steps.why: The account's character limit, once. Each part counts on its own.

contents.content: We shipped the new dashboard today. Three things changed.
1. Every number now links to the posts behind it.
2. Results load in under a second. 3. Exports work on mobile.

media.alt_text: The new dashboard showing weekly results

steps.why: Parts only go in through bulk-create-posts, as a nested contents list; each part is checked against the limit on its own. Media inside a part is media_url (a url key there is dropped). Poll bulk-create-status for the created_post_id.
A bulk-created post has no X settings, and without them Bolta posts parts 2 and 3 as separate posts, not replies. Saving any X setting creates them.

say: Saved to Acme as a draft X thread: part 1 is the post, parts 2 and 3 go out as replies, with your screenshot on part 3. Nothing goes out yet. Schedule it, or change a part?
never: create-post for a thread: it saves part 1 only.
update-post to change part 2 or 3: it edits part 1 only.
A video on X: it takes images only.
